Bincode encode and decode helpers, error codes, and decode allocation macros.

# Purpose
This header defines the `fd_bincode` support code used to encode and decode binary data in fixed and variable length formats. It provides context structures for read and write buffers, error codes, and inline helper functions for primitive values, `bool`, raw byte arrays, compact `u16` values, and `varint` values. The file also defines archive meta tags and helper functions to write and verify length fields for nested archive data. At the end, it provides macros that simplify decoding into `spad`, scratch, or static storage by first checking the footprint and then performing the decode.
